unmapped_findings: Reported final mechanical properties after process control: nearly 1 GPa yield strength, 28% total elongation, and toughness up to 1.72 kJ/mol (238 J/cm³).
The B2 second phase (Fe-Al-based intermetallic) was characterized as Fe(Ni,Mn)Al, enriched in Fe, Mn, Al, and Ni with negligible carbon solubility.
High-speed HR refines B2 stringer bands, reducing the stringer band fraction from 16% to 11%, thereby enhancing the austenite fraction and delaying crack propagation.
